description: This file implements the While class which provides a 'while' loop construct for a mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It defines the logic to evaluate conditions, execute nested operations, and handle break/continue flow control within the loop. It also includes a factory class to instantiate While objects based on XML elements.

classes.name: While
classes.description: Implements a 'while' loop for the mini-language, evaluating a condition and executing nested operations repeatedly until the condition is false or a break occurs.

classes.name: WhileFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of While from XML configuration elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the while loop by evaluating the condition and executing the nested operations, handling break and continue exceptions appropriately.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact-related information from all sub-operations.
